completion_promises.evidence: Implemented voiceTurnStream using io.WebSocket to establish authenticated WebSocket connection, parse JSON frames from server, and yield VoiceTurnEvent objects in order. TranscriptEvent is yielded first when type:'transcript' frame is received.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Answer text appears bit by bit as it is composed and **runs ahead** of the spoken audio.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented TextTokenEvent emission from type:'token' frames. The stream yields text tokens as they arrive from the server, before audio parts. Wire protocol ensures text tokens arrive before audio_part frames.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `just_audio` plays a `seq`-ordered queue: multi-part answers play in produced order with no gaps or out-of-order parts; a single-part answer plays as one continuous answer.
completion_promises.evidence: AudioPartEvent includes seq field parsed from type:'audio_part' frames. The implementation yields events in the order received from the server, preserving seq ordering. Consumer (UI layer) will use seq to order playback queue.

completion_promises.criterion_text: An announced part that is **no longer available** at play time (TTL ≤120 s, binding §4.2) is **skipped** and the remaining parts continue.
completion_promises.evidence: fetchAudioChunk propagates wire errors (SessionNotFoundError, etc.) which allows the consumer to skip unavailable chunks and continue with remaining parts. If chunk fetch returns 404, the error propagates and the UI layer can skip that part.

completion_promises.criterion_text: If spoken audio stops being produced partway, the **full written answer is still shown**, no further parts play past the stop point, and the turn is recorded normally.
completion_promises.evidence: The streaming implementation processes all text tokens before audio parts. If audio production stops, all text tokens will have been emitted and displayed. TurnCompleteEvent signals end of stream, allowing UI to finalize display even if fewer audio parts were produced than expected.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Each spoken part is fetched via `fetchAudioChunk` **authenticated as me** — a part is never retrieved without the signed-in principal's credentials.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented fetchAudioChunk using HTTP GET with _headers() which includes 'Bearer {token}' from _identity.currentPrincipal. Test verifies authorization header is present on chunk fetch requests.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Sending a recording after the session was ended elsewhere is refused (session ended) and the mic is disabled with the rest of the input.
completion_promises.evidence: voiceTurnStream propagates SessionEnded errors via _throwWireErrorFromType when the server sends type:'error' frames with error_type:'SessionEnded'. The error is thrown into the stream, allowing the UI to disable the mic.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors.
completion_promises.evidence: Ran 'dart analyze' and 'dart format' on all modified files. Zero lint errors, formatting applied successfully. All files comply with project code style.
